_about: Data for the daar station v2 (design system §13), the combined station js/cook/stations/daar.js: v3 (29 Sept play-test, D1): the swipe chop again (js/cook/mechanics/chop.js, its own levels, decoys and timer), the pieces waiting at the side, then the tadka in the pot on the kitchen kit's hob (one burner, one pot: the knob, the spices in the order Nani says, the chopped vegetables, the daar) and stir as many times as Nani says. Serve and taste (§14a). mechanic.levels (merged in order): vegDecoys / spiceDecoys (extra crates and jars on the shelf), spiceShelf (where the spice decoys come from), ladder (how Nana's card shows the tadka order in the cook: words, or closed = the card starts folded to face + headline and a peek costs a hint, §14a; no dots or hidden rows: no pips, and a hidden section would let the card fold with its check early), (v3, S16: no oil-heating ring; the oil is hot at once and the sizzle says so. The stir's speed dial reads data.mechanics.stir's bands.) `phases`: one English line per job (placeholders, like every station goal).

station.name: Daar
station.goal: Swipe to chop what Nani says, add the spices in the order she says, then stir as many times as she says.

phases.chop: Swipe to chop what Nani says, before the timer runs out.
phases.cook: Turn on the hob, add the spices in the order Nani says, then the chopped vegetables and the daar.

levels.stirLine: Stir round the pot as many times as Nani says, then tap the tick.
